name: unconnected v1.0.0
body:
**unconnected v1.0.0 — First release**

Take control of when selected callers can reach you.

Choose phone numbers from your contacts or add them manually, set your weekly calling hours, and turn the filter on or off whenever you need.

- Flexible weekly schedules
- Multiple phone numbers
- Easy contact selection
- Works offline
- No account required

**Requires Android 10 or later.**

Download the APK below, install it on your phone, and follow the in-app setup instructions.

Call screening behavior may vary depending on your device and how incoming calls are identified.
